question: us-policy-positions:transportation-infrastructure.mileage-fee-replaces-fuel-tax
definition: yes = state law operates a per-mile road usage charge in which enrolled drivers pay by the mile instead of (or credited against) the fuel tax or its flat-fee substitute, in operation on 2026-01-01; no = no operating per-mile charge (pilots and studies only; flat annual EV registration fees and weight-distance truck taxes do not count).
summarySource: Per-state primary pages fetched 9/28/2026: statute and agency pages for the four yes states (ORS 319.885 and ODOT OReGO; Utah Code 72-1-213.1 and UDOT; Va. Code 46.2-773, Acts 2020 c. 1230 and DMV Mileage Choice; HDOT HiRUC program page and 6/30/2025 release); Washington bill history on app.leg.wa.gov; for each no state, its own fuel tax statute, EV fee statute, pilot bill or revenue agency page.

US-AL.note: Per-gallon gasoline tax ($0.30 from 7/1/2025) applies; the only per-mile item listed is a motor carrier mileage tax on buses (Ala. Code § 40-19-3), which is not a road usage charge replacing the fuel tax.

US-AK.note: Alaska levies a per-gallon motor fuel tax and surcharge; no per-mile road charge.

US-AZ.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax ($0.18) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-AR.note: Arkansas DFA administers per-gallon motor fuel taxes; no per-mile road charge. The page does not state rates.

US-CA.note: Pilots only: SB 1077 (2014) created the road charge pilot and SB 339 (2021) extended the pilot program to 1/1/2027; the fuel tax (Rev. & Tax. Code § 7360) remains.

US-CO.note: SB 21-260 added a per-gallon 'road usage fee' on fuel and annual electric vehicle fees, not a per-mile charge.

US-DE.note: Per-gallon gasoline tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-FL.note: Per-gallon motor fuel taxes apply; no per-mile road charge.

US-GA.note: The motor fuel excise tax under § 48-9-3 applies (its collection was suspended by executive order in spring 2026, after the reference date); no per-mile road charge.

US-HI.note: Electric vehicles only: from 7/1/2025 owners choose a per-mile charge ($8 per 1,000 miles, capped at $50) or a flat $50, both replacing the $50 EV registration surcharge; HDOT says per-mile becomes mandatory for EVs by 2028. Cite omitted because the statute page (capitol.hawaii.gov, HRS § 249-36 / Act 222 of 2023) refused the request.

US-ID.note: Electric vehicles pay a flat $140 annual fee, not a per-mile charge.

US-IL.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax ($0.483 on gasoline from 7/1/2025) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-IN.note: Indiana collects a gasoline excise tax and gas use tax per gallon (collection suspended by a 2026 energy emergency order, after the reference date); no per-mile road charge.

US-IA.note: Per-gallon motor fuel excise tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-KS.note: Per-gallon motor-vehicle fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-KY.note: Per-gallon motor fuels taxes apply (rates reduced from 7/1/2026); no per-mile road charge.

US-LA.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax ($0.20) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-ME.note: Per-gallon fuel tax (30.0 cents) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-MD.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-MA.note: Per-gallon gasoline excise applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-MI.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-MN.note: Electric vehicles pay a flat annual registration surcharge rather than a per-mile charge; the fuel tax is Minn. Stat. § 296A.07.

US-MS.note: Mississippi collects gasoline and special fuel taxes under its Gasoline Tax and Special Fuel Tax laws; no per-mile road charge. The page does not state rates.

US-MO.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-MT.note: Per-gallon gasoline tax (33 cents) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-NE.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-NV.note: Per-gallon motor vehicle fuel taxes apply; no per-mile road charge.

US-NH.note: Per-gallon road toll on motor fuel applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-NJ.note: Per-gallon motor fuels tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-NM.note: Per-gallon gasoline tax ($0.17) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-NY.note: Per-gallon motor fuel excise tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-NC.note: Per-gallon motor fuel excise tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-ND.note: Per-gallon motor vehicle fuel tax (23 cents) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-OH.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-OK.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax ($0.19 on gasoline and diesel) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-OR.note: OReGO is voluntary: enrolled drivers pay a per-mile charge (set by ORS 319.885 at 5% of the per-gallon tax) and get a credit for fuel tax paid; ODOT launched it 7/1/2015. HB 3991 (2025 special session, subject to referendum petitions per the ORS note) phases in a flat-or-per-mile choice for electric vehicles from 7/1/2027 and hybrids from 7/1/2028.

US-PA.note: Per-gallon motor fuel taxes apply for 2026 ($0.576 per gallon on gasoline from 1/1/2026); no per-mile road charge.

US-RI.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-SC.note: Per-gallon motor fuel user fee applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-SD.note: Per-gallon fuel excise tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-TN.note: Tennessee imposes gasoline and diesel taxes among its motor fuel taxes; no per-mile road charge. The page does not state rates.

US-TX.note: Per-gallon gasoline tax (20 cents) applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-UT.note: Voluntary and limited to alternative fuel vehicles, whose owners may pay a per-mile charge in lieu of the flat annual alternative fuel vehicle fee (a fuel-tax substitute); the statute says the program began 1/1/2020. The only version the legislature site serves is the one effective 7/1/2026, so the 1/1/2026 text was not read directly.

US-VT.note: Per-gallon motor fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-VA.note: Mileage Choice is voluntary for vehicles subject to the highway use fee (the fuel-tax substitute for efficient and electric vehicles) and charges per mile, capped at that fee; Acts 2020 c. 1230, enactment 6, made § 46.2-773 effective 7/1/2022.

US-WA.note: The 2025 road usage charge bills (SB 5726 and companion HB 1921) got only a committee hearing and were reintroduced in 2026 without passing; SB 5801 (the 2025 revenue package) contains no per-mile charge.

US-WV.note: Per-gallon motor fuel excise tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-WI.note: Per-gallon motor vehicle fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.

US-WY.note: WYDOT administers Wyoming's fuel tax under Title 39, ch. 17; no per-mile road charge. The page does not state rates.

US-DC.note: Per-gallon motor vehicle fuel tax applies; no per-mile road charge.
